messages.content: "你能計算多項式函數 '3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7' 的導數，並在x=4時評估這個導數嗎？接下來，你可以把產生的結果函數再計算一次導數並在x=2時評估嗎？"

function.name: calculate_derivative
function.description: Calculate the derivative of a polynomial function. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

x_value.description: The x-value at which the derivative is calculated. Optional, if not given, the function will return a function of the derivative instead of a specific value. default is 0.

message.reasoning: The user wants to compute derivative of polynomial "3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7". Then evaluate at x=4. Then take resulting derivative function and compute its derivative again, then evaluate at x=2. We need to use the tool calculate_derivative. The function expects a string representation of polynomial function. The user gave "3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7". That is a polynomial. We can pass that string. The tool will compute derivative. Then we need to evaluate at x=4. The tool can also accept x_value optional. So we can call with x_value=4. That will return numeric derivative at x=4. Then we need to take that derivative function (which is a function of x) and compute its derivative again. But the tool expects a string representation of polynomial function. We need to provide the derivative function as a string. The derivative of "3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7" is "9x^2 - 4x + 5". So we can pass that string. Then evaluate at x=2. So we need to call tool twice: first with function="3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7", x_value=4. Then second with function="9x^2 - 4x + 5", x_value=2. The tool will return numeric values. Then we output them. The user didn't ask for the derivative function itself, just the numeric evaluations. So we can do that.
